stem.text: A box of mass $4.9\,\text{kg}$ is pushed at a constant velocity from point P at the bottom of an inclined plane to point Q at the top.
The box is pushed by a force of $64\,\text{N}$ acting parallel to the slope.
The slope is inclined at an angle of $20^{\circ}$ to the horizontal and the box moves through a vertical height of $5.8\,\text{m}$.

stem.alt: Inclined plane rising from P at the bottom right to Q at the top left, with a box on the slope, a force arrow labelled 64 N parallel to the slope, a vertical height marked 5.8 m and an angle marked 20°.

stem.text: What is the work done against the frictional force acting on the block between P and Q?
